metadata.name: Dwarf Fortress (Legacy)
metadata.summary: Classic ASCII-based fantasy world simulation and fortress management game

content.value: Dwarf Fortress (Legacy) is the acclaimed, classic fantasy simulation game developed by Bay 12 Games. Players take control of a fledgling colony of dwarves attempting to build a thriving fortress in a richly simulated, procedurally generated fantasy world filled with deep history, geological layers, diverse ecosystems, and legendary beasts.
This portable package bundles the original ASCII interface experience along with all necessary runtime dependencies, ensuring high portability across Linux distributions without requiring FUSE.

items.value: Procedural generation of entire fantasy worlds complete with continents, historical figures, civil war chronicles, and mythologies
Detailed fortress management encompassing mining, masonry, agriculture, crafting, military defense, and trade
Intricate tracking of individual dwarf psychology, physical health, skills, social relationships, and personal preferences
Classic grid-based ASCII graphics offering the traditional and lightweight Dwarf Fortress visual presentation
FUSE-less portable execution with an integrated prompt-based update check mechanism
